name: Soulforge Lost Path
detailed_description:
On the Three Deceivers
Faith demands the surrender of thought; Truth withstands all questioning.

Whispers in the Abyss
Faith rends your soul—you are but a stray lamb. Yet bloodshed and death may grant fleeting clarity.

Your Mandate
Walk your path. Claim the truth you seek.

Game Introduction

Soulforge: Lost Path fuses Survivors-like chaos with loot-driven extraction. As a legendary medieval hunter lost in the spirit realm, you will:

  • Confront endless hordes of Corrupted Souls in the Twisted Soulprison

  • Reap visceral satisfaction through hellish horde-slaying

  • Scavenge Sacred Remains and Infernal Relics from fallen horrors

  • Master ruthless inventory tetris within limited carry space

  • Forge Exorcist Artefacts at the demon-forged anvil

  • Unearth the rot festering at the world’s core

Core Mechanics

Ⅰ COLLECT REMAINS → FORGE ARTEFACTS
"Bones never lie useless. They crave purpose. Bring them to the Blacksmith—he speaks in fire and steel."

Ⅱ COIN CHIMES → FLESH ASCENDS
"Weak limbs falter; frail souls shatter. The avaricious Mage brokers cosmic power... for a price."

Ⅲ WINNOW CHAFF → CLAIM ESSENCE
"Leave trinkets; seize revelations. The fallen’s gifts exceed your grasp. Seek the Tailor—he stitches space from shadows."

Ⅳ GREED CONDEMNS → YET GAINS ENDURE
"Treasures blind. Take only what you can carry; flee what you cannot slay. When all slips away, the scavenger Merchant salvages fragments of loss."

Voices from the Void

The Church’s Edict
"The Church gathers all stray lambs to the Shepherd. Surrender your blade, confess your sins, and bathe in His grace: Death shall not claim you."

The Pactkeepers’ Whisper
"Demons seek no tribute. Lay down your arms—revelry awaits. Even a sliver of ‘paradise’ gleams in their contracts... They hunger only for your void beyond death."

Epilogue
O Lamb... may you carve your truth from the darkness.

Simplified Chinese*, English*
*languages with full audio support

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11（64位）
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 或更高 内存（RAM）
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 支持DX11或以上的独立显卡（GTX 1060 或更高）
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
